Character motion

Nine authored Blender clips for each new body plan. Attack, defend, celebrate and perish play once; other clips loop. Perish is a gentle non-graphic topple. Replay restarts a finished action.

Drag or middle-drag to orbit. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Shift-scroll, Shift-drag or right-drag to pan. Two fingers dolly/pan. Fit resets the close-up.

Source shapes are unchanged. Limbs use rigid pivots, not deforming skin. The floating charm intentionally has detached hands and feet. Asset registration and game integration remain separate.
